assessment.summary: This study reports the development of a multiplex high-resolution melting (mHRM) assay to genotype V1016I and F1534C mutations in Aedes aegypti populations from Argentina. The study is ineligible because it focuses on Aedes aegypti, not Anopheles, and is conducted in South America, not Africa.
